authority_base_note: origin/main after Merge PR #45 (Part B elevation NO_GO dual-slice alignment + Path A sufficiency).

prior_no_go_authorization.supersession_scope: Only the blanket prohibition on any SI-008 open is superseded. Dual-slice alignment/sufficiency acceptances remain valid. Path B write, production registration, mint/admission/Kernel write, and Part B PASS inference bans remain in force unless separately authorized below.

named_open.named_target_meaning: Allow a narrowly defined promotion path in which Path A evidence Claim-IR structural packages may be classified as Part B EVIDENCE-track candidacy under explicit request fields; this is not automatic elevation from Path A GREEN and is not Part B PASS.

hard_ban_unchanged: Path A readonly GREEN MUST NOT be inferred as L2 PASS, Part B PASS, or unrestricted Part B elevation.

clarification.what_go_means: Owner authorizes a named, narrow opening of PB-SI-008 so the dual-track gate may recognize PATH_A_EVIDENCE_CLAIM_IR_STRUCTURAL_CANDIDACY_V0_1 for EVIDENCE promotion candidacy only.
clarification.what_go_does_not_mean: Does not enable write path, production registration, mint/admission, Kernel write, certificate/STOP, CLAIM/AUTHORITY/PASS_CONDITION promotion, or treat Path A GREEN as Part B PASS.
